sources.summary: Pitch-circle backlash is rotational travel between opposite flank contacts with the mate held. Normal clearance uses a contact condition, unlike a neutral unloaded pose. Tooth thinning contributions from both gears add.

interpretation: The existing parameter removes 0.12 mm circumferential thickness from EACH gear at its pitch circle, so ideal pair play is 0.24 mm. The actual polygonal helical exports require a two-sided contact check. Service comparison assumes tangential pitch-circle indicator measurement; retain that assumption until the measurement setup is corroborated.
